market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have historically been a top-4 side, finishing in the top 4 in four of the last five seasons. With a strong squad, stable management, and significant resources, a top-4 finish in 2025-26 is more likely than the 52.5% implied by the market. I estimate their true probability at ~75%.
evidence_points: Liverpool finished top 4 in 4 of the last 5 EPL seasons, missing only in 2022-23 (5th).
The club retains elite players (Salah, Van Dijk, etc.) and a proven manager, giving them a high baseline of performance.
Despite competition, the Premier League's top 4 usually consist of a consistent group, and Liverpool are firmly in that group.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of EPL standings through 2024-25 season
